_readme: Where each app draws its own interface over a vertical video. Graphics and captions are kept out of these areas. Values are fractions of the frame, measured from typical 9:16 phone layouts of each app; they are approximations (each app changes its layout now and then), so a margin is included. top / bottom: bands across the full width. right: the column of buttons (like, comment, share) between railTop and railBottom. left: a small side margin.
